title: Studio S3 feasibility simulator: validation on SYNTHETIC worlds
disclaimer: Educational planning tool. Not financial, legal or lending advice. Lenders make their own decisions.
scope: Validation on SYNTHETIC worlds whose generator the same author wrote (src/uwcopilot/studio/feasibility/worlds.py and validation.py). It checks internal consistency and the effect of misspecification; it is not evidence of real-world accuracy.

dscr_target.label: lender policy (SYNTHETIC Northwind guideline NBC-4.2), editable
dscr_target.source: corpus/guidelines/northwind_business_credit.md NBC-4.2, term loan minimum decision DSCR (SYNTHETIC document of a fictional institution; also the NSP-4.1 threshold of the SYNTHETIC startup program)

method.worlds: worlds.py: each world draws a plan and a loan, then anchors the site's most likely demand so the one-forecast year-2 DSCR equals a drawn target; worlds that cannot reach it at capacity are kept and counted as n_worlds_not_anchored
method.well_specified: the true path is one more draw from the simulator's own model
method.misspecified: the true path adds Student-t(3) monthly noise scaled to unit variance, a mean-one lognormal site demand error (log-sd 0.25), and with probability 0.3 a 6-month downturn cutting demand by a uniform 0.2-0.5 share
method.band_coverage: share of the 36 months whose true value lies within the forecast P10-P90 (inclusive), averaged over worlds
method.brier: mean of (forecast probability - true 0/1 outcome)^2 over worlds; lower is better
method.single_forecast_baseline: every input at its most likely value, no shocks, no noise; read as a yes (1) or no (0) forecast
method.base_rate_baseline: a constant forecast equal to the share of the same worlds with the outcome (in-sample, so it is optimistic)

timing.note: wall time on a shared 4-CPU machine used by several agents at once; see provenance.environment for the load average at the start and the end of the run

real_metros: not measured: no real outcome data exists for any metro, so no real-world accuracy can be computed

provenance.corpus_checksum: not applicable (no retrieval corpus is used)
